title: Agentic AI 学习路线图
summary: 该项目提供了一份全面的 AI 学习路线图，涵盖 Python 基础、数学、机器学习、深度学习、LLM 及 Agent 系统，侧重动手项目、实用工具与真实部署。
summary_en: A comprehensive AI learning roadmap covering Python fundamentals, mathematics, machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, and agentic systems, focused on hands-on projects, practical tools, and real-world deployment.
